10 EMA ↑ 20 EMA screener — FAQ

What is the 10 EMA ↑ 20 EMA stock screener?
10-day EMA crossed above the 20-day EMA in the last 5 trading days (event detection). It scans India stocks and currently lists 515 matching companies, refreshed every trading day.
How often is the 10 EMA ↑ 20 EMA screen updated?
The screen is recalculated every trading day after market close using the latest price, volume and fundamental data.

515 India stocks currently match the 10 EMA ↑ 20 EMA screen.
